notes: Run each prompt on Haiku, Sonnet and Opus with the plugin enabled. The gate is binary: shared files => context-pack mandatory; disjoint modules => no pack.

evals.name: gate-yes-shared-files
evals.prompt: Review the diff of this branch with 4 parallel sub-agents: security, performance, naming and test coverage.
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator builds the context-pack once before dispatching the lenses, and every lens reads the pack instead of re-scanning.
expectations: Runs scripts/context-pack.mjs exactly once before the 2nd agent is dispatched
Dispatches the lenses read-only (readonly-lens agent or Read/Grep/Glob only)
Every lens prompt starts with the same prefix: 'Lens: <name>. Checks: <one line>. Pack: <path>'
Lens output is OK/KO plus one line per finding, with no narration
No edits happen until all findings are collected; fixes are applied in a single pass

evals.name: gate-no-disjoint-modules
evals.prompt: In parallel, research how the payments module, the clock module and the crm module each handle retries. Each agent should stay in its own module.
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator skips the context-pack because the agents open disjoint files, but still asks for terse read-only output.
expectations: States that the modules are disjoint, so the pack is skipped
Sub-agent output is still terse (OK/KO plus one line per finding)

evals.name: second-pass-reuse
evals.prompt: Run the same 4-lens review again on the same target after I fixed the first round of findings.
evals.expected_output: The orchestrator searches memory before dispatching and reuses the existing pack if the target is unchanged, or regenerates it deterministically if it changed.
expectations: Searches memory (claude-mem or .token-economy/memory.md) before dispatching lenses
Checks whether the cached pack still matches the target before reusing it
Findings already listed in SHARED-FOUND or memory are not re-reported
Writes new findings to memory once, from the orchestrator, after the run

evals.name: single-agent-no-trigger
evals.prompt: Rename the variable tmp to buffer in src/parser.js.
evals.expected_output: Single-agent edit: no fan-out, no context-pack, no lens agents.
